paragraphs.text: Ulasht is a legendary hydra that inhabits the ruins of Ravnica left behind by the Gruul Clans . Ulasht is unique in that its multiple heads are hellions , a worm-like creature with tentacles surrounding a tooth-filled mouth.
Though not officially a part of any clan, it is revered by many Gruul as a natural embodiment of pure destruction and mindless rage.
